verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm OpenAI-compatibility: switching to Together requires only changing the API key and base URL, meaning existing chat-completions code (including function/tool calling, which agent frameworks rely on) works unmodified. This directly supports mid-workflow provider switching without provider-specific rewrites. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of drop-in compatibility across real agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain/AutoGen) and no explicit mention of full parameter parity across all endpoints.
